atoms.span: Lee Sharks uses asynthetic synthesis to designate a methodological principle
What is asynthetic synthesis?
The August 2026 Operative Semiotics: A Grundrisse — Notebook X: The Gate gives an especially explicit formulation.
Asynthetic synthesis retains the aspiration to meaningful relations between positions while refusing to require their integration into a single resolution.
When two plates contradict each other, the contradiction is retained as a seam.
the asynthetic principle itself risks becoming a doctrine
The notebook describes its units as plates, rather than sections in a continuous argument.
Its philosophical achievement, if successful, is to distinguish relational intelligibility from conceptual assimilation.
the seam is not simply a missing connection. It becomes an identifiable epistemic object.
